title.en: Pick Rows and Columns from the Table

brief.zh: 在 pandas 里切换区域和列组合，看同一张表能回答哪些问题。
brief.en: Switch the area and column selection in pandas and see what questions one table can answer.

concept.zh: 列名帮助挑选信息，查询条件帮助挑选记录。
concept.en: Column names select fields, while the filter selects records.

hints.zh: 先显示所有区域，再只看仓库。比较结果行数和列名。
hints.en: Show all areas, then only Storage. Compare the row count and the column names.

prompt.zh: 选择区域和列组合，比较每次输出的行数和列。
prompt.en: Choose an area and column set, then compare the output rows and columns.
